source.scope: Top 20 of RotoWire's 2026-27 Power Conference Top-200 fantasy rankings plus eight targeted players in the board's top-60 draft priority/category top-40 who also appear in the public cheat-sheet. The ranking pool covers the ACC, Big 12, Big Ten, Big East, and SEC. The article says rankings are primarily for DraftKings-scoring points leagues with G, F/C, and UTIL slots. MIN, PTS, REB, and AST are from the article's 2026-27 projection cheat-sheet table. One additional targeted omission, Rodney Rice (rank25), read October27 at12:02-12:04UTC; earliest observation and October20 publication label retained.
